Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when the response replays the first answer of the same Idempotency-Key.

gtin.description: GS1 GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits) with a valid mod-10 check digit; variable measure GTINs (indicator digit 9) are refused. Answered normalised to 14 digits. One GTIN identifies one item or pack level.

packaging.description: Every pack level ever declared, lowest level first (retired ones have active false). Omitted when the item has none.

400.description: idempotency-key-required or idempotency-key-invalid (state-changing routes); invalid-limit, invalid-cursor or unknown-query-parameter (list reads); malformed-request-body (bad JSON, an unknown field, a wrong type, an empty body, trailing data or a NUL character) or malformed-request-query (a NUL character).
